regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-concentrated leadership structure in Canada/TSX with precious metals (Gold Miners, Silver & Royalties) clearly outranking all other themes, but absorption is low (0.31) and no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped drawdown control on this market (gate_helps: true), so eligible leaders with healthy durability may warrant lean-positive attention, but the cross-sectional momentum rank itself carries no return edge.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper is rank 3 with a 'mean-revert' Hurst tag and low breadth (0.667), so it may be fading rather than forming leadership. Watch whether its score sustains above 1.2 for two consecutive weeks while breadth rises toward 0.8 — that would move it from watch into a callable theme.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners holds the top momentum rank with the highest durability bar (0.66), excellent breadth (0.933), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.54). The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, making the leading eligible theme with strong internal confirmation a sensible trend-following lean — with the understanding that the rank itself is not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The Hurst tag is 'mixed' and r10 is slightly negative (-0.0054), suggesting the trend may be stalling; a crowded-cap view could reverse quickly if precious metals sentiment cools, and the rank-IC on momentum is near zero.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite by more than 8% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties ranks second with a strong score (1.627) and broad participation (0.917), closely tracking the Gold Miners leadership without being crowded. This looks like a precious-metals complex continuation rather than a rotation; a modest overweight expresses the trend continuation without treating the rank as alpha.
theses.dissent: It uses the same ETF proxy as Gold Miners (XGD.TO), so this leans the same underlying exposure; if gold mining sentiment inflects, both positions lose simultaneously, doubling concentration risk.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses its relative strength versus the S&P/TSX benchmark and trails by more than 8% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only theme in the ranks with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, sits in eligible territory (score 0.75), and shows a solid durability bar (0.66). In a broad rotation where financial infrastructure themes are not crowded, a low-conviction lean captures the trend-health signal of the staying-power leg.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.429, meaning less than half of constituents are participating; the trend tag may be concentrated in a few names, and a broad-market shift toward precious metals leaves financials lagging.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its 60-day price level relative to XGD.TO before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
